title: Henry D. Moyle
vital_facts: Born 1889 at Salt Lake City, Utah
Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married Clara Alberta Wright 1919; eight children
Ordained Apostle and sustained to Twelve 1947-1959
Second Counselor to David O. McKay, 1959-61
First Counselor to David O. McKay, 1961-1963
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
